parsed.result_reading: The robot falls mostly backward (4/4 seeds fell backward, 0 forward). Median fall time 1.33 s, time_upright 1.33 s. COM velocity is negative (-0.284 m/s mean, -0.99 m/s at end), indicating backward motion. Torso pitch is negative (-0.283 rad mean, -0.75 rad at end), showing a backward lean. Capture margin is negative (-0.227 mean, -0.753 at end), meaning the capture point lies behind the support interval. Angular momentum is negative (-0.033 mean, -0.111 at end), indicating backward rotation. Step frequency is within healthy range (3.5 Hz), but step length over leg length is low (0.049 vs healthy 0.157-0.231). Double support and flight fractions are high, suggesting a shuffling gait with little forward progression. No torque saturation or slip observed. Overall symptoms point to insufficient forward propulsive balance correction.
